question: Does starting Video Talk plus accepting browser camera permission authorize model-triggered frame sends for the session, or must each capture have stronger user indication or approval?
rationale: The patch creates a new sensitive-data egress boundary where the model decides when a camera frame is transmitted, and repository evidence does not establish the permanent consent policy maintainers want.

options.title: Approve bounded session consent
options.body: Treat explicit Video Talk start, browser permission, persistent preview, bounded frame size, and a capture-rate limit as sufficient consent for model-triggered snapshots.

options.title: Require per-capture indication
options.body: Add a visible capture event or confirmation before each JPEG leaves the browser, accepting additional interaction latency for stronger privacy signaling.

options.title: Pause camera egress
options.body: Keep the feature unmerged until a broader camera and provider-media policy is defined for Talk surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded session consent
recommendation.body: Treat explicit Video Talk start, browser permission, persistent preview, bounded frame size, and a capture-rate limit as sufficient consent for model-triggered snapshots.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body records this person's product approval, and prior mainline history connects them to the browser Talk and realtime-provider surface.
